Job description:
Hiring Senior Executive AI Specialist for KHATIB GROUP. We are looking for a senior specialist who is fully proficient in the field of Artificial Intelligence; an individual with strong scientific backing and proven practical experience in designing and implementing real organizational solutions, to technically lead AI projects and process intelligentization. Responsibilities: • Design, architecture, and implementation of end-to-end AI solutions for key organizational processes • Development, training, and optimization of machine learning/deep learning models and fine-tuning of large language models • Design and build intelligent agents (AI Agents) and integrate them with organizational systems (CRM, ERP, etc.) • Leading the deployment of models in the operational environment (MLOps) and continuously monitoring, evaluating, and improving their performance • Analyzing the needs of various business units and converting them into actionable and scalable technical solutions • Providing technical guidance and supervising the quality of work by other technology team members. Education and Qualifications: • Master's or Ph.D. in fields such as Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Statistics, or related fields from reputable universities • Minimum of 5 years of specialized and practical work experience in developing and implementing AI projects (not just educational/research) • Successful execution of at least one AI project at the real organizational scale, available as a portfolio • Relevant documents, specialized courses, or scientific publications count as points. Required Skills: • Full mastery of Python and specialized libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers) • Mastery of Large Language Model (LLM) architectures and APIs, prompt design, RAG, and building intelligent agents • Mastery of big data processing and related tools (SQL, Pandas, NumPy, Spark) • Professional experience with databases, design, and development of RESTful API web services • Mastery of Git, Docker, and MLOps/CI-CD principles for stable model deployment • Strong analytical and algorithmic thinking, ability to solve complex problems, and independent technical decision-making • Proficiency in specialized English for studying scientific resources and the technical documentation of the modern world

Company description:
FaraTose'e Khatib Auto Company has been active for more than a decade in the field of selling cash and installment cars. It has a safe and calm environment that enables career advancement and progress for everyone.
